title: A day for each package
notes: d = 8, a day for each package if need be, so the heaviest package, 8, is the answer: the bottom of the range. Binary search still halves its way down through 22, 15, 11, 9 and 8, which all fit: 5 checks and 40 reads. Trying upward gets it on the first check, with 8 reads. Here the naive way wins.
